tasks.description:
Eric Edmeades Page

Thinking the navigation should include:

*HOME*
*ABOUT*
*PROGRAMS* (instead of SERVICES or COACHING) or *COMPANIES* or *HELP* (acronym for Human Evolution Labs Programs) and links to the Human Evolutions Labs page OR we can put “Human Evolutions Labs” as a button somewhere?
*BOOKS* (remove from Human Evolution Labs page)
*MEDIA* (remove from Human Evolution Labs page) for podcast, substack, research work, etc.
OR consolidate BOOKS and MEDIA into *CONTENT* or *RESOURCES* (and this section would include his books, podcast, substack, research work, etc)


(A good reference of someone with a similar personal brand and multiple companies is https://www.jordanbpeterson.com/)

Remove “Start Now” button or maybe this becomes a “Book Eric to Speak” button (that would go to a speaking inquiry form)

Can we tighten/revise this section copy to:
*Architect of Human Transformation* (remove “The” and capitalize each word)
Closing the gap between ancient biology and modern potential (remove your/your for less words)

Also this section tweak copy to:
Eric Edmeades is a serial entrepreneur, award-winning international speaker, and leading human behaviour expert. He is the creator of programs, assessment tools and an ecosystem dedicated to mastery in health, influence and impact including Wildfit, Speaker Nation, Business Freedom, and the AZAYA Experience.

Change “The 4 Pillars of Mastery” to “Key Pillars of Human Transformation & Mastery” (as I think he will create more like a relationships mastery program, etc)
Change “Ecosystems designed to align your life with your potential” to “Ecosystems of programs, resources, and tools designed to align your life with your highest potential

For *TESTIMONIALS* section I think we should put copy or video’s of what people say about Eric and move the Assessment tools there currently to the Human Evolution Labs page (and add the Stop It Style Assessment tool from the brief here too so all 3 assessment tools are here)

Footer
Remove RESOURCES and just list final nav headings
Remove VENTURES and just list companies (that will lead to each site)
Add GET IN TOUCH or CONTACT field

Rest of the sections not mentioned above look good!

tasks.title: Homepage - Design
tasks.description:
Update Homepage Design
Due: ASAP. Please prioritize

See attached file for the compiled feedback from their call

Here is the Summary of their call: 
Summary: Kieran and Elliot discussed website design updates for The Menopause Coach, with Kieran providing feedback on color schemes, font sizes, and content placement. Kieran expressed concerns about the current brown color scheme, preferring to align with his existing logo's three colors for a more holistic therapy appearance. They discussed specific changes needed, including moving the "Second Spring" section higher on the page, using larger fonts for better readability, and adjusting claims about personalized nutrition plans and natural approaches. The conversation also touched on personal topics, including Kieran's housing situation and Elliot's challenges with his sister's care, before concluding with plans to review the updated design with Dili later.
